name: mindb Release Announce
description: After a release tag, update docs/index.html changelog and open PR.

workflow.prompt:
A mindb release was published. Webhook payload includes `tag`, `repo`, and `release_url`.

## Task

1. Fetch GitHub Release notes for the tag from the payload.
2. Update `docs/index.html`: prepend a new entry in `#changelog` with `<time datetime="YYYY-MM-DD">` and 1–2 user-facing bullets (no implementation jargon).
3. Match existing landing tone: minimal, terminal-calm, teal/dark brand.
4. Open a PR branch `release/announce-<tag>` with only `docs/index.html` (and `docs/styles.css` if needed).

## Rules

- User language only.
- No roadmap or speculative features.
- If release notes are empty, summarize from commits since previous tag.

PR title: `docs: announce <tag> on landing page`
